content: {"memo": "Recommendation: Award to CoolStream HVAC Equipment. CoolStream's stated total is $1,285,000, the lowest stated bid, but its leveled total is $1,300,500 after plugging two unpriced items: factory performance test ($9,000) and vibration isolation ($6,500). Frostline Thermal Systems' stated total is $1,290,500, but its leveled total is $1,331,500 after plugging crane and rigging to roof ($26,000) and BMS integration ($15,000); Frostline also has an unpriced gap for a 5-year compressor warranty. On a leveled basis CoolStream is lower by a 2.4% margin. Before award, clear CoolStream's qualification risk: lead time of 36 weeks from release. Frostline's risks, a 5-year parts-only compressor warranty and short 30-day price validity, are noted but not conditions for CoolStream."}
